youtube.title: D. B. Cooper: The Man Who Jumped and Vanished (Full Case File)
youtube.description:
On 24 November 1971, a man calling himself Dan Cooper hijacked Northwest Orient Flight 305, collected $200,000 and four parachutes in Seattle, and jumped from the 727's rear stairs into a rainy night over southwest Washington. Fifty-five years later, the FBI still doesn't know who he was. This is the complete case file: the note, the demands, the jump, the largest manhunt of its era, the money found on a Columbia River beach in 1980, the suspects, and what the evidence really says about whether he survived.

📂 Case File #004: D. B. Cooper — full documentary
